source_caption:
📺 The Ms. Pat Show (2021–Present)

The Ms. Pat Show follows Patricia “Ms. Pat” Carson, an outspoken mother and former convicted felon who has transformed her difficult past into a new life with her family in suburban Indiana. Inspired by comedian Ms. Pat’s real-life experiences, the series explores the hilarious and sometimes emotional challenges of raising children, maintaining a marriage, and navigating complicated family relationships. Alongside her husband Terry, sister Denise, and their children, Pat faces everything from parenting disagreements and financial struggles to unexpected family drama. With her fearless personality, sharp humor, and brutally honest advice, Pat tackles life’s challenges in her own unforgettable way. Combining outrageous comedy with heartfelt moments, The Ms. Pat Show explores family, resilience, forgiveness, and second chances.

🎭 Genre: Comedy • Family • Sitcom

⏱️ Runtime: Approximately 30 minutes per episode • TV-MA

🎥 Creators: Patricia Williams-Lee & Jordan E. Cooper

🏆 Awards: Primetime Emmy-nominated comedy series.

📺 Where to Watch: Paramount+ in the United States. Availability varies by region.

source_details.synopsis: The Ms. Pat Show is an American television sitcom created by Jordan E. Cooper and Patricia "Ms. Pat" Williams that premiered on the streaming service BET+ on August 12, 2021. The show is based on the comedy and life story of comedian Ms. Pat as a convicted felon from the streets of Atlanta turned reluctant suburban mother. The series has received nominations for 4 Primetime Emmy Awards for Outstanding Directing for a Comedy Series.
